id: nominal core steps.lvlib::nominal core steps.lvlib:get channel buffer from batch buffer.vi
path: teststand steps support\get channel buffer from batch buffer.vi
description:
In the batch buffer, register a channel by name and tag and get a direct reference to the underlying buffer, or look up an existing buffer. 

Tags are part of the unique identification of a channel, but are not required.

Examples:
Call with "name", <no tags>; Call with "name", <no tags> => one channel
Call with "name", <no tags>; Call with "name", tags: [sn: 123] => two channels
Call with "name", tags: [sn: 123]; Call with "name", tags: [sn: 321]  => two channels

terminals.description: error in can accept error information wired from VIs previously called. Use this information to decide if any functionality should be bypassed in the event of errors from other VIs. Right-click the error in control on the front panel and select Explain Error or Explain Warning from the shortcut menu for more information about the error.
